reason: Under V2, ClientPermissionsV2.hasPermission (patch lines 493-508) falls back to the all-clients resource whenever a client has no resource of its own, so canMapRoles and canMapCompositeRoles also return true for the realm-management client. RolePermissions.canMapRole (RolePermissions.java:307-308) and canMapComposite (RolePermissions.java:397-398) return true straight away in that case, without calling checkAdminRoles (lines 149-287), so an admin holding that grant can map admin roles such as realm-admin.
